name: rock_spire
title: Pointed rock spires from tall 75° slopes, each tip capped with a cheese slope turned another way, side by side at different heights.
why: A builder reaches for it to stand sea stacks in the surf or a ragged ridge along a cliff top.

name: rock_facet
title: A rock face broken into angled planes by cheese slopes pressed onto side studs, pointing up, down, left, or right.
why: A builder reaches for it to make any brick rock face look broken instead of flat.

name: cliff_wall
title: A cliff face of ordinary bricks whose courses step in and out by a stud, in mixed grays, with a ragged top.
why: A builder reaches for it for any cliff, quarry, or rocky base under a landscape.

name: rock_outcrop
title: A lump of rock: a brick core leaned on all round by slopes of different steepness, with double-convex corners and cheese chips on top.
why: A builder reaches for it to drop a boulder or rocky outcrop anywhere on a baseplate.

name: surf_line
title: A beach of tan plates on water with a wandering edge and broken white surf of tiles and cheese slopes at the waterline.
why: A builder reaches for it to edge any island, lake shore, or coastline.

name: river
title: A stream of clear tiles over a blue bed, a plate below its banks, whose grass overhangs the water in places.
why: A builder reaches for it to run a river or stream across a layout.
note: At large sizes it may use a 2 x 14 plate, made in Blue in only one or two sets.

name: waterfall
title: Water pouring over a rock lip and down the face as clear tiles hung on side studs, with white foam at the foot.
why: A builder reaches for it to put a waterfall on a cliff or into a river.

name: pond
title: A small sunken pond of clear tiles with rounded corners over a blue bed, with lily pads, rim stones, and reeds.
why: A builder reaches for it for a garden or park pond, or a pool in a forest scene.
note: At large sizes it may use a 2 x 14 plate, made in Blue in only one or two sets.

name: grass_edge
title: A grassy top on a cliff whose edge wanders, overhanging in rounded tongues and stopping short in places, locked by a second plate layer.
why: A builder reaches for it to finish the top of any cliff or rock wall naturally.

name: hillside
title: Ground rising in terraces two plates high, each front softened by cheese slopes in grass and bare earth.
why: A builder reaches for it to make a gentle hill or bank instead of a flat baseplate.
note: At large sizes it may use a 2 x 14 plate, made in Green in only one or two sets.

name: flagstone_paving
title: Crazy paving of tiles in mixed sizes and two grays laid at random, with a few jumper plates and bare studs.
why: A builder reaches for it for courtyards, quays, garden paths, and worn floors.

name: dirt_path
title: A path two studs wide winding across the grass in tiles, its bends rounded with 1 x 1 corner-round tiles, with pebbles beside it.
why: A builder reaches for it to lead a path through a garden, park, or field.
note: Its bends use 1 x 1 corner-round tiles; the 2 x 2 'corner round' tile in the library is the curved quarter-ring, which left holes.

name: pine_tree
title: A conical fir of tiers of slopes on plates, each tier narrower and held clear of the one below by its core, on a round trunk.
why: A builder reaches for it for forests and winter scenes where the classic leaf tree looks wrong.
note: Uses the same tier method as snow_cap (slopes facing out round a core, each tier two studs narrower); here each tier sits on its own plate, held clear of the one below.

name: bush
title: A leafy shrub of round bricks with bamboo leaves on a round plate, turned outward in two greens, crowned with broad leaves.
why: A builder reaches for it to dot gardens, parks, and forest floors with low greenery.

name: flower_bed
title: A bed of soil plates with a tile border, planted with leaf clumps, flowers on stems, and low leaves, spaced so blooms never touch.
why: A builder reaches for it to put flowers in front of a house or in a park.
note: The flower head part (3742) doesn't seat on a plain stud in the validator, so the blooms are round plates with tabs (33291), a stud apart, with low green round plates between.

name: cave_mouth
title: A dark cave entrance in a rock face: an arch on rock jambs, black bricks set back inside, buttresses and broken rock over it.
why: A builder reaches for it for a cave, a mine, or a sea cave in a cliff.

name: snow_cap
title: A mountain peak of stacked tiers of slopes, gray rock below, white snow above, and a ragged snowline between.
why: A builder reaches for it to top a mountain in a winter or alpine scene.
note: Uses the same tier method as pine_tree; it stacks the tiers tight and mixes white and gray for the snowline, so it can read as a plain pyramid.

name: footbridge
title: A plank bridge over a stream: stringers on stone footings, a deck of tile planks in mixed browns, and handrails on posts.
why: A builder reaches for it to cross a stream or ditch in a park, farm, or forest.

name: woodpile
title: A stack of cut logs seen end on, round tiles in wood colors on side studs, each row shorter so the pile tapers.
why: A builder reaches for it beside a cabin, farm, or campsite.

name: landing_zone
title: A field of open studs the exact size of a module built apart, framed by a ring of tiles with triangular cut corners.
why: A builder reaches for it whenever a house or tower is built separately and dropped onto the landscape.
